SETTINGS.D35EHealthConfigInstructions: Configure the health computation parameters for the various types of actors. You can use @totalHD variable to reference creature total HD, and @sourceHD to reference total hd from source (Class levels or Racial HD).
SETTINGS.D35EHealthRoundingHint: Health values must be whole numbers.  Round up, nearest, or down?
SETTINGS.D35EHealthContinuityHint: Health can be computed discretely or continuously.  Discrete health is rounded at each level, meaning creatures will receive a stable amount of health for each hitdie.  Continuous health is rounded after each source of hitdie is evaluated, meaning creatures will receive a fluctuating amount of health for each hitdie.
SETTINGS.D35EHealthConfigWoundsAndVigorP: Use the Wounds and Vigor optional ruleset for player characters.
SETTINGS.D35EHealthConfigWoundsAndVigorN: Use the Wounds and Vigor optional ruleset for nonplayer characters.

This item has Unique ID set. It is designed to be added to characters only by adding it as class or race ability.

Remember to start your own UIDs with user- prefix.

D35E.LightControlledToken: Lighting settings on this token are set using items on actor (like torches or magic items). Settings below will be overridden from actor data. To change this, go to Actor settings page.
D35E.NoTokenOverrideH: This option disables overriding Token image and size from actor, so you can use animated token images. This disables automatic size and image change when using Alter Self and Change buffs! This setting will be in effect after next actor update after changing it.
D35E.NoLightOverrideH: This option disables overriding Token light settings from items. This disables functionality of torches and magic items that shed light! This setting will be in effect after next actor update after changing it.
D35E.DropChargeLinkItem: Drop Item with charges to link charges/uses.
D35E.LinkedChargeDescription: If linked with another item, this item will use charges from that item.
D35E.ValuePersisted: This value will be persisted between rolls done with this item

D35E.RechargeFormulaInfo: This formula is used when resting to recharge random amount of charges on item. To make item recharge to max, leave it empty.
D35E.RechargeItemConfirmation: This item will be recharged as if character has rested with Recharge Items option enabled. Do you want to proceed?
D35E.LockEditingByPlayersDesc: Locks this character sheet from being edited by non-GM users. This setting can be changed only by GM.

D35E.PartyRested: Everyone have rested. Daily uses have been reset, and characters were healed.

D35E.AttributeDamageConfigHint: Ability damage and ability drain will be reflected on the ability score. Ability penalty will only affect the modifier, not the score itself.
D35E.NumberOfAttacksAutocalculated: Extra attacks were automatically calculated. If you want to disable that behaviour, set Scale Attacks Number with BAB to Never.
D35E.AttackBonusInfo: These bonuses do not take into account dynamic combat changes that may be provided by feats like Weapon Focus or Weapon Specialization.
D35E.DropItemWithUID:
You are trying to add item with UID to an actor. These items should be added only by Automatic Class Features functionality.

If you still want to add this item to the actor, you can add it without UID by clicking the button below.

Removing UID will only remove it from a copy added to the actor.
D35E.MigrationText: System needs to migrate to newer version. This process is generally safe but in certain edge cases my break items and characters.
D35E.MigrationTextUser: System needs to migrate to newer version. This process can be done only by a GM. You cannot use the system unless the GM migrates the world!
D35E.ErrorActionFormula: Error while executing Special Action. Action "{action}" encountered an error: {error}.
D35E.DamagePoolInfo: Enabling Damage Pool support allows the buff to auto expire if actor takes amount of damage (similarly stoneskin spell). To work correctly, the buff must also provide energy resistance or damage reduction.
D35E.TimelineTickOnEndOfRound: Progress buff on the end of Turn.
D35E.WarnAttackRollIncorrect: Attack bonus cannot be calculated for item {name} (incorrect roll {roll})
D35E.VisionControlledByActor: The vision system is controlled by the actor (Senses menu, Items and effects). To disable that, turn on the option "Do not override Token Vision" in config tab.
D35E.VisionNoAutomation: "Do not override Token Vision" is turned on. You can manually set vision here, but vision automation will not work.
D35E.AoOForcedNone: No eligible actors for opportunity attack
D35E.ModifiedFormulaNeedsAmpersand: When using field referenced in Modified Formula, Modified Field needs ampersand before the field name.
D35E.WarningAbilityLevelChange: You cannot change the ability level as the same ability at the same level already exists.
D35E.CreateSpecialActionFromTemplateHint: This will create a Special Action from a template. You can then edit it to your liking.

Uses standard Foundry texture for sidebar Background when using theme
SETTINGS.D35EAutoScaleAttackBABN: Automatically scale number of attacks for Characters using Weapons

SETTINGS.D35EPlayersNoDamageDetailsL: Disallow players from expanding and showing damage details

SETTINGS.D35ERepeatAnimationsL: By default 3.5e SRD disables .webm repeat. This settings changes that so animated tokens can work better.
SETTINGS.D35EDisableTokenLightsL: This option disables overriding Token light settings from items globally. WARNING: This disables functionality of torches and magic items that shed light! This setting will take effect after each actor/token update!
SETTINGS.D35EHideTokenConditionsH: Whether buffs should hide their icons from token status effects
SETTINGS.D35ECoreEffectsH: Displays only 3.5e conditions on tokens (unchecked) or core icons as well (checked)
SETTINGS.D35ECurrencyNamesH: Coin names, from Platinium to Copper, divided by comma. Enter any text, leave empty to use default.
SETTINGS.D35EHideSpellDescriptionsIfHasA: Hides Spell Description chat card if spell has Action
SETTINGS.D35ESaveAttackWindowL: Enabling this will save per-item attack window values (wield mode, selected ammo, attack bonus etc).
SETTINGS.D35EDisableTutorialL: Disables tutorial for all players in this world
SETTINGS.D35EApiKeyPersonalH: Your personal Players's Companion API Key - use it if you keep you character on your account
SETTINGS.D35EApiKeyWorldH: Player's Companion API Key used by default for all characters in this world.
SETTINGS.D35EAllowNoAmmoN: Allow no Ammo for ranged weapons
SETTINGS.D35EAllowNoAmmoH: Allows players to use ranged weapons without ammunition
SETTINGS.D35ECurrencyConfigHint: Allows you to define custom Coins and group them into Currencies
SETTINGS.D35ENoAutoSpellpoinCostH: Disables automatic calculation of spellpoint cost
SETTINGS.D35ESpellpointsCostFormulaH: Custom spellpoint cost formula. Use @level to get spell level. Leave empty to disable
SETTINGS.D35EDisableTokenVisionL: This option disables overriding Token vision settings from items globally. WARNING: This disables functionality of torches and magic items that change vision! This setting will take effect after each actor/token update!
SETTINGS.D35ERollConfigConfigInstruction: This options sets up default roll mode for different roll types for different actor types.

SETTINGS.D35EPsionicsAreDifferentL: Splits Spell Resistance into Power and Spell Resistances
SETTINGS.D35EFullAttackChatCardL: Show Full Attack chat card on full attack roll
SETTINGS.D35ESharedVisionModeH: How to handle Shared Vision between players.
SETTINGS.D35EShowPlayerContextNotesH: Displays context notes in chat cards to Players.
SETTINGS.lsPurchaseChatMessageHint: If enabled, a chat message will display purchases of items from the loot sheet.
SETTINGS.lsClearInventoryHint: If enabled, all existing items will be removed from the Loot Sheet before adding new items from the rollable table. If disabled, existing items will remain.
SETTINGS.lsChangeIconForSpellScrollsHint: Changes the icon for spell scrolls to a scroll icon. If left unchecked, retains the spell's icon.
SETTINGS.additionalCachedCompendiums_cla: Compendiums to cache for Class Abilities
SETTINGS.additionalCachedCompendiums_rac: Compendiums to cache for Racial Abilities

SETTINGS.additionalCachedCompendiums_dam: Compendiums to cache for Damage Types

D35E.ls.permissionLimited: Limited (access to sheet but cannot do any action)
D35E.ls.priceModifierTooltip: This uses a percentage factor where 100% is the current price, 0% is 0, and 200% is double the price.
D35E.ls.priceModifierText: Use this slider to increase or decrease the price of all items in this inventory.
D35E.ls.convertLootMessage: Are you sure you want to convert all items into coins? Items will be sold for 50% of their price (except TradeGoods). Unidentified items will be sold based on unidentified cost.
D35E.ls.noAccesToSheet: You don't have access to that Loot/Merchant sheet!
D35E.ls.typeInfo: Loot: allows for distribution of coins across players. Merchant: allows players to purchase items directly from the sheet.
D35E.ls.permissionsInfo: Ensure players have selected a character via the Player Configuration (right-click player in bottom left) menu.
D35E.ls.merchantInfo: Replace this merchant's inventory with a random number of items from a Rollable Table. Specify the Rollable Table's name, along with how a formula for how many different items to add (Shop Qty Formula), and a formula for determining how many of each item to add (Item Qty Formula).
D35E.ls.enableDraggingTooltip: A player can drag an item from the loot. Be careful because the item will not be removed from the loot and no message will be displayed in the chat log. When disabled, players are forced to use the loot action to take something.
D35E.ls.maxCapacityTooltip: Maximum number of items in the loot (empty or 0 means unlimited)
D35E.ls.maxLoadTooltip: Max weight that can be put in the loot (empty or 0 means unlimited)

D35E.ls.buyContent: Are you sure you want to buy {item}?
D35E.patreonLocked: This feature is exclusive to Patreon supporters. Coming soon.
D35E.ContainerActiveHint: Treat the item as on the character: effects apply and actions are usable, but no equipment slot is used
D35E.ContainerDropHint: Drag items here to add them to the container
D35E.ContainerNestingForbidden: A container cannot be placed inside another container
D35E.IntuitiveHint: Check = manually enable (blocks automatic damage settlement for this target); uncheck = manually disable (items/feats can no longer force it on); untouched = follow items/feats.
SETTINGS.D35EAutoApplyIntuitiveHint: When enabled: targets without "Block Auto-Apply" and without optional advanced combat options have attack damage settled automatically (defense dialog skipped); targets with "Block Auto-Apply" or optional advanced combat options get the defense dialog for manual settlement.
D35E.AutoApplyBlockedTooltip: Has "Block Auto-Apply" — damage to this target must be settled manually
D35E.ToggleIntuitiveBindingHint: Press the key to toggle "Block Auto-Apply" for the selected token; different sounds play when enabling/disabling.
D35E.ToggleChatViewBindingHint: Switch chat sidebar between Chat and Rolls views (default key U, configurable in settings)
D35E.CGMPAllowPlayersDescHint: Allow players to use the /desc description command (italic, centered, grey); /as remains GM-only
D35E.CGMPNotifyTypingHint: Show a 'Someone is typing...' notice at the bottom of the chat when other players are typing
D35E.DTEnableTrayHint: Shows a quick dice row below the chat input (left-click adds, right-click subtracts, draggable).
D35E.DTEnableCalculatorHint: Click the dice icon in the chat form to open the calculator dialog.
D35E.DTHideAdvHint: Hides the kh/kl buttons in the tray and calculator.
D35E.DTEnableInlineHint: Chat messages with [[2d6+3]] will be parsed and rolled automatically. May conflict with macros using [[ ]] syntax.
D35E.setting.reset.name: Reset settings to default

D35E.settings.disableChatPortrait.name: Disable chat portrait

D35E.settings.useTokenImage.hint: Use the actor's Token image instead of the actor's standard image.

D35E.dialogs.nosystemfound.title: System Not Recognized
D35E.dialogs.nosystemfound.content:
This system is not currently fully supported. This means that the module does not know how to best handle this system's items, but can still operate in a limited fashion.

You can configure the module's settings yourself, but it requires a bit of technical know-how.

If you have any questions, ping Wasp#2005 on the Foundry discord.
